title: Dedicated portable Master Structural runtime request metadata
description: The JSON text is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Keys must occur exactly once, with no trailing JSON. Endpoint tokens use integer decimal syntax; spread uses a plain decimal token of at most 64 bytes without exponents. Require warmupFromT < tradeFromT < tradeToT. Source and exact six-column BTB1 bytes are separate bounded arguments; see docs/master-structural-runtime.md.
